title: Shipped a game where AI wrote the code and I removed the AI from the game
author: dmcr85
selftext:
A slightly odd data point for this sub. My virtual pet game Nudii was written mostly by Claude Code. Version 1.0 also had generative AI inside it: you could chat with your pet through a model running on the phone.

For 2.0 I took the in-game AI out and replaced it with a scripted voice. Why:

* The model made the download 3.7 GB and locked the game to the newest iPhones.
* A pet with hand-written lines has more character than a pet that can say anything.
* Scripted lines can be tested and translated. Generated ones are much harder to vouch for.

AI as a tool for building the game: huge win. AI as a feature in this game: not worth its cost.

Free on iPhone, 130 countries (not the EU yet): [https://nudii.app](https://nudii.app/)

Curious whether others here have pulled a generative feature back out.
